question: Which VLAN must be assigned as the ACI infra VLAN when running the APIC setup script during initial configuration?
options: the same VLAN as the management VLAN
any VLAN already used elsewhere in the network
a unique VLAN within the network
theory: The ACI infrastructure VLAN carries all internal fabric control-plane traffic between APICs, leaf switches, and spine switches, so it must never overlap with any VLAN already used elsewhere in the network — the APIC setup script explicitly requires this VLAN ID to be unique and unused anywhere else, unlike a tenant or management VLAN which can freely coexist with other network VLANs. Reusing VLAN 1, the management VLAN, or an already-in-use VLAN would create conflicts with Layer 2 domains outside the fabric, which is why only a genuinely unique VLAN satisfies the requirement. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 4 — ACI Infrastructure VLAN Requirements)
